title: MOTION (HUTT - LEE) relative to funding needed to pay the costs of printing and installing banners as part of the FIFA World Cup celebrations in Council…
text:
[Council File 26-0628; CD 10]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (HUTT - LEE) relative to funding needed to pay the costs of printing and installing banners as part of the FIFA World Cup celebrations in Council District 10.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
AUTHORIZE $42,263.86 in the Council District 10 portion of the Council Discretionary Street Furniture Fund No. 43D/50 be allocated to Happy Village for services related to the printing and installation of street banners for the 2026 Watch Party Festival that was hosted in Council District 10 for the FIFA World Cup and that the Board of Public Works, Office of Accounting be authorized to make any payment to Happy Village in the above amount for the above purpose, and to prepare and process any other documents as may be required for this purpose.
AUTHORIZE the Bureau of Street Services and/or Board of Public Works, Office of Accounting to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
